outside_schema.IDN-0026: Module allocation inferred from surviving suffixes; session.rs and synth_engine graph.rs.
outside_schema.IDN-0027: Session-only NoteSnapshot and undo restoration in undo_flow.rs and pattern.rs.
outside_schema.IDN-0029: Runtime ModuleId and script_seed_base in synth_engine commands.rs and graph.rs.
outside_schema.IDN-0031: CLI and corpus TrackSelector in render/mix.rs and corpus/mod.rs; not the song schema.
outside_schema.IDN-0032: Public runtime hub registration; hub.rs and exports; no repository serialization found.
outside_schema.IDN-0033: Public command-batch correlation; transactions.rs and exports; no repository serialization found.
outside_schema.IDN-0037: Runtime VoiceId, HostKey, NoteEventKey and fallback_note_seed; authored seed values also occur in the schema.
outside_schema.IDN-0039: Experimental lowering identity.rs, modulation.rs and buses.rs; no persistent encoding.
outside_schema.IDN-0041: ContentRevision and owner/session-scoped ProjectRevision, SourceVersion and graph generations; dirty.rs, shared_song.rs, egui_backend.rs and song.rs.
outside_schema.IDN-0042: Session MergeKey, EffectChain and undo snapshots in undo.rs; typed targets are existing entity references.
